defaults.x: Accessible & Ethical, Minimalism & Swiss Style, Micro-interactions
defaults.d: none needed: the app home is the dashboard
defaults.c: A friendly brand colour with a calm neutral ground; one extra colour for success, never colour alone
defaults.t: Real screenshots, ratings with their source, a plain privacy summary, data export and delete, support address
defaults.b: No booking; an in-app free tier or trial

rows: Habit Tracker
habit, streak, routine, daily, goals, reminders, check in, tracker
Make missing a day gentle: never shame, offer a restart. Show a week at a glance and let reminders be tuned or silenced.
Timer & Pomodoro
timer, pomodoro, focus, countdown, breaks, work sessions, stopwatch
Big numerals, one start button and a sound or vibration that can be turned off. Keep running when the screen is locked.
Alarm & World Clock
alarm, world clock, time zones, wake, snooze, clock, cities, ringtone
Alarms must be reliable and silent mode honest. Show time zones with city name and offset in words.
Calculator & Unit Converter
calculator, unit converter, currency, scientific, history, conversion, maths
Keys must be large and the result unmistakable. Show the history, copy result, and say how often rates update.
Weather App
weather, forecast, rain, temperature, radar, wind, alerts, hourly
The next hours matter most, then the week. Show alerts first, units the user picks and the data source.

rows.x: Glassmorphism, Soft UI Evolution, Accessible & Ethical

rows: Recipe & Cooking App
recipe, cooking, ingredients, steps, meal plan, shopping list, timer, kitchen
Design for messy hands: large type, step by step, screen stays on. Scale servings and show metric and imperial.

rows.x: Editorial Grid / Magazine, Soft UI Evolution, Accessible & Ethical

rows: Grocery & Shopping List
grocery, shopping list, groceries, share list, aisles, pantry, items, supermarket
Adding an item must take one tap. Share lists live with a household, sort by aisle, and work with no signal.
Wardrobe & Outfit Planner
wardrobe, outfit, closet, clothes, planner, style, capsule, packing
Photographing clothes must be quick. Let people tag, filter and plan a week, and keep photos private by default.

rows.s: Editorial Grid / Magazine + Soft UI Evolution

rows: Plant Care Tracker
plant care, watering, houseplants, garden, light, reminders, species, identify
Show next watering for each plant and remind with context. Species advice should name its source.

rows.x: Nature Distilled, Flat Design, Accessible & Ethical

rows: Book & Reading Tracker
reading tracker, books, shelf, goals, reviews, library, progress, isbn
Scan to add a book. Show a shelf and a gentle yearly goal; keep reviews private unless shared.

rows.s: Editorial Grid / Magazine + Soft UI Evolution
rows.x: E-Ink / Paper, Flat Design, Accessible & Ethical

rows: Couple & Relationship App
couple, relationship, shared calendar, questions, memories, partner, private, together
Privacy is the product: say who can see what, and how to leave and delete together. Avoid pressure to perform.
Family Calendar & Chores
family calendar, chores, kids, shared, schedule, rewards, household, planner
One shared view with colours per person that also carry initials. Kids' accounts need parental controls and no ads.
Mood Tracker
mood, emotions, journal, patterns, check in, wellbeing, daily, insights
Check-in in two taps; insights should be careful, not diagnostic. Show crisis resources and keep the data local if possible.
Gift & Wishlist
gift, wishlist, registry, birthday, ideas, share, reserve, surprise
Reserve without spoiling the surprise for the owner. Accept links from any shop and keep a clear price field.
Diary & Journal App
diary, journal, entries, prompts, private, mood, memories, writing
Private by default with a lock that does not lose entries. Offer export to plain text and a calm writing view.
Parenting & Baby Tracker
baby tracker, parenting, feeding, sleep, nappies, growth, milestones, newborn
Usable one-handed at night: dark mode, big logging buttons. Share with a partner, export for the doctor, and avoid guilt about benchmarks.

rows.x: Dark Mode (OLED), Accessible & Ethical, Flat Design

rows: Pet Tech App
pet, dog, cat, vet records, feeding, tracker, microchip, health
Keep records for each pet with vaccine dates and reminders. Share with a vet or sitter by link.
Home Decoration & Interior Design
interior design, home decor, rooms, furniture, ar preview, moodboard, inspiration, layout
Let people try furniture in their own room with scale correct. Link products to real prices and shipping.

rows.s: Editorial Grid / Magazine + Soft UI Evolution
rows.x: Quiet Luxury, 3D Product Preview, Minimalism & Swiss Style

rows: Drawing & Sketching Canvas
drawing, sketch, canvas, brushes, layers, pencil, tablet, art
The canvas gets the screen; tools hide. Pressure and palm rejection must work, and files must export in open formats.

rows.x: Flat Design, Soft UI Evolution, Micro-interactions

rows: Photo Editor & Filters
photo editor, filters, retouch, crop, presets, exposure, edit, camera roll
Before-and-after in one gesture, and non-destructive edits. Show export sizes and keep original files untouched.
Short Video Editor
video editor, clips, trim, captions, music, export, reels, timeline
Timeline in a thumb zone, captions as a first-class tool and quick export sizes for each platform. Be clear about watermark rules.
Music Creation & Beat Maker
beat maker, music production, loops, sequencer, samples, daw, synth, studio
Pads, loops and a clear transport. Latency matters more than looks, and sample licensing must be stated.

rows.s: Dark Mode (OLED) + Tactile Digital / Deformable UI

rows: Meme & Sticker Maker
meme, sticker, templates, caption, gif, share, remix, creator
Make-and-share in under a minute. Respect image rights, give caption fonts that pass contrast and export to chat apps.

rows.s: Gen Z Chaos / Maximalism + Vibrant & Block-based

rows: AI Photo & Avatar Generator
ai photo, avatar, generator, portrait, styles, prompts, headshot, credits
State what happens to uploaded faces and how long they are kept. Show real outputs, credit costs and an easy delete.

rows: Generative Art Platform
generative art, ai art, prompts, gallery, prints, models, canvas, collection
Credit artists, state training and licence rules, and let people see how a piece was made. Gallery first, tools second.

rows: Wallpaper & Theme App
wallpaper, theme, backgrounds, icons, widgets, lock screen, customise, packs
Preview on a device frame and download the right size. State licences and keep ads out of the preview.

rows.s: Vibrant & Block-based + Gradient Mesh / Aurora Evolved

rows: White Noise & Ambient Sound
white noise, ambient, sleep sounds, rain, focus, mixer, timer, relax
Play instantly in one tap and keep going with the screen off. Offer a sleep timer and offline sounds.
Meditation & Mindfulness
meditation, mindfulness, breathing, sessions, calm, sleep stories, guided, teacher
Start a session in two taps, no streak shame. Credit teachers, state what the practice is not, and keep trial terms clear.

rows.x: Nature Distilled, Clinical Calm, Minimalism & Swiss Style

rows: Yoga & Stretching Guide
yoga, stretching, poses, routines, mobility, video, guide, beginner
Show each pose with a clear photo, breath and cautions. Offer short routines and flag when to stop.
Sleep Tracker
sleep, tracker, bedtime, alarm, sleep score, snoring, wearable, routine
Evening view must be dim and nothing flashes. Report with humility: it is an estimate, not a diagnosis.
Calorie & Nutrition Counter
calories, nutrition, food diary, macros, barcode, meals, weight, diet
Scanning and a trustworthy food database matter most. Avoid shame language and let users hide numbers.

rows.x: Accessible & Ethical, Minimalism & Swiss Style, Micro-interactions

rows: Period & Cycle Tracker
period, cycle, ovulation, symptoms, predictions, fertility, privacy, health
Privacy first: say that data stays on the device or how it is protected, and give an anonymous mode. Language must be inclusive and predictions labelled as estimates.
Medication & Pill Reminder
medication, pill reminder, dosage, refill, prescriptions, schedule, caregiver, adherence
A missed reminder is a safety risk: alerts must be reliable and large. Offer a caregiver view and never give dosage advice.

rows.x: Inclusive Design, Flat Design, Soft UI Evolution

rows: Water & Hydration Reminder
water, hydration, reminder, daily goal, bottle, intake, notifications, health
One tap logs a glass. Keep reminders optional and goals adjustable, and avoid medical claims.
Fasting & Intermittent Timer
fasting, intermittent, timer, eating window, 16:8, tracker, hours, health
Show the clock clearly and warn about who should not fast. Never gamify extreme fasts.
Running & Cycling GPS
running, cycling, gps, route, pace, distance, splits, training
Glanceable stats in motion: big numbers, high contrast, haptic cues. Offer map privacy zones.
Fitness/Gym App
fitness app, workouts, gym, training plan, sets, reps, coach, progress
Logging a set must take two taps. Show progress honestly and offer rest and deload weeks.
Biohacking / Longevity App
biohacking, longevity, biomarkers, supplements, wearable, labs, protocols, health data
Be careful with claims and cite studies. Explain what each biomarker means with ranges and say when to see a clinician.

rows.x: Minimalism & Swiss Style, Clinical Calm, Soft UI Evolution
